evaluation.gt: fixed calibration labels only on s1050; s1051 scoring only after predictions

fit: none; no new fitted constants; frozen floor appearance/calibration/pulse profiles
method: Seegmiller 2011 plane optical-flow odometry: LK + calibrated ground homography + RANSAC rigid SE2. Adapt nominal pulse Q by innovation covariance scaling (Popescu 2026 equations 13-15); pulse-local M=1, no recursive scaling. Only extra zero-mean process covariance; no mean reset, velocity stop, or wall-observation rejection.
noise: alpha=max(1,(innovation dot innovation - trace(R))/trace(Q)); Q_effective=Q*sqrt(alpha); extra=Q_effective-Q. SE2 units m,m,rad; paired-pulse residual only, no GT. Missing/unobservable flow leaves Q unchanged. Extra covariance injected at settled capture timestamp before its wall update on existing 160 ms delayed provider.
full_rule: Only if every gate passes, reserve a new bundle and unused seed, commit preregistration, run one S2 DEV full. Otherwise stop without simulation.
limitations: Observed DEV data, not independent confirmation. Covariance-only candidate cannot remove systematic mean bias. RANSAC floor assumption and camera compliance can invalidate VO; unknown never means stationary. Wall images reused for process uncertainty may correlate with AMCL; no independent measurement success claim. No common port/other controllers change.
